# Update the SimpleNote "Venmo Expenses" note with this month's total.

note_id = 3084
old_content = note['content']
lines = old_content.splitlines()

# month_short already computed as e.g. "05/23"
amount_formatted = f"{total_amount:.1f}"
month_entry_line = f"- {month_short} => ${amount_formatted}"

new_lines = lines[:]
existing_idx = None
for i, ln in enumerate(new_lines):
    if ln.strip().startswith(f"- {month_short} =>"):
        existing_idx = i
        break

if existing_idx is not None:
    new_lines[existing_idx] = month_entry_line
else:
    header = new_lines[0] if new_lines else '# Venmo Expenses'
    remainder = new_lines[1:] if new_lines else []
    new_lines = [header, month_entry_line] + remainder

new_content = "\n".join(new_lines)

print('month_short:', month_short)
print('month_entry_line:', month_entry_line)
print('old_content_preview:', '\n'.join(lines[:6]))
print('new_content_preview:', '\n'.join(new_lines[:6]))

update_res = apis.simple_note.update_note(
    note_id=note_id,
    access_token=simple_note_access_token,
    content=new_content
)
print('update_res:', update_res)

# Verification (single read)
updated_note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=simple_note_access_token)
print('updated_at:', updated_note.get('updated_at'))
print('---updated content---')
print(updated_note['content'])

# Success check value existence
assert month_entry_line in updated_note['content']
